scripts.text:
Secret Passage to ^25C18DNinja Guild^25C18D
You hear familiar voices talking to each other.
scripts.translation:
通往^25C18D忍者公会^25C18D的秘密通道
你听到熟悉的声音在交谈。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
Long time, no see. How are you? How are the kids you've taken in?
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 A]
好久不见。你最近怎么样？你收留的那些小孩还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
I have to hand it to you. You've picked some competitive ones.
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 B]
不得不承认，你挑的人很有竞争力。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
Sounds like music to my ears. Being sent to a foreign land with air pollution was bad enough, now haunted with memories of this place...
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 A]
这话我爱听。被派到那个空气污染严重的异国他乡已经够糟了，现在还要被这个地方的回忆所困扰...

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
What do you think? Should we rotate now?
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 A]
你觉得呢？我们现在该轮换了吗？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Haven't given up, have ya. Do you really think he'll approve?
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 B]
看来你还没放弃啊。你真觉得他会批准吗？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
No need to be bitter. Hey! Were any of the kids that come and go here the ones that found the ^BD0408place^BD0408?
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 A]
别这么酸嘛。嘿！那些来来去去的小孩里，有发现^BD0408那个地方^BD0408的吗？

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Since finding the hidden place was also a part of the test.
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 B]
毕竟发现那个隐藏的地方也是考验的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice A]
You are as stubborn as the first time I met you. It's just a wall in some place...
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 A]
你和你第一次见面时一样固执。那只是某个地方的一堵墙而已...

scripts.text:
[Unknown Voice B]
Shssh! I think someone is eavesdropping. Hurry! Go back to the mission area.
scripts.translation:
[未知声音 B]
嘘！好像有人在偷听。快！回到任务区域去。

scripts.text: The conversation stopped abruptly. Hidden place? Wall? Part of a test? What is all this about?
scripts.translation: 对话突然停止了。隐藏的地方？墙？考验的一部分？这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text: You should no longer use this secret passage.
scripts.translation: 你不应该再使用这条秘密通道了。

scripts.text: You found a location that resembles the hidden place.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一个与隐藏地点相似的地方。

scripts.text: This wall was here ever since. How come I didn't notice it before?
scripts.translation: 这堵墙一直都在这里。为什么我之前没注意到？

scripts.text: Now that I know it's a secret passage, what do I do to get in?
scripts.translation: 既然知道这是条秘密通道，我该怎么做才能进去？

scripts.text: Tear the drawing down.
scripts.translation: 撕下画

scripts.text: Touch the drawing with your hand.
scripts.translation: 用手触摸画

scripts.text: I can't rip it down because I don't own it.
scripts.translation: 我不能把它撕下来，因为它不是我的。

scripts.text: You touch the drawing with the tip of your hand and felt a sudden sensation of being pulled.
scripts.translation: 你用指尖轻轻触碰了那幅画，突然感到一股被拉扯的感觉。

scripts.text: Entrance to the ^25C18DNinja Guild^000000 hideout.
scripts.translation: ^25C18D忍者公会^000000据点的入口。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text: When touching the drawing, you get the feeling of being pulled...
scripts.translation: 触摸这幅画时，你会感到一股被拉扯的感觉...

scripts.text: There is a wall with a great drawing on it.
scripts.translation: 墙上挂着一幅巨大的画。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
You don't need to carry so many things.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你不需要携带这么多东西。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
You are not in the clan of the Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
你并不属于忍者一族。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6An old man looking hale and hearty is sitting and gazing vacantly.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6一位看起来精神矍铄的老人正坐着，目光呆滞地望着前方。^1A95E6

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
^1A95E6You tried to talk to the old man but there is no response. Just when you are about to turn away...^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你试图与老人交谈，但他没有回应。就在你准备转身离开时...^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
At last, a customer! Hmm... and a live one, too!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
终于有顾客了！嗯...还是个活人！

scripts.text: Excuse me... where am I?
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...我在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
^1A95E6He keeps talking and doesn't stop to answer your question.^1A95E6
scripts.translation:
[老人]
^1A95E6他一直在说话，并没有停下来回答你的问题。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
There once was a quiet clan living in ancient Amatsu times that is never mentioned in history books or stories.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
在古老的樱花城时代，曾有一个安静的氏族，他们从未被记载在历史书籍或故事中。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They lived beneath shadows but always yearned for the bright sun, like a sunflower.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他们生活在阴影之下，却总是渴望明亮的阳光，就像向日葵一样。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
A clan that was loyal to their lord who they served as their bright sun.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这是一个忠诚于其领主的氏族，他们将领主视为他们的太阳。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
...a very trustworthy clan...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
...一个非常值得信赖的氏族...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
....loyal to their core...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
....从心底里忠诚...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
...a clan of integrity...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
...一个正直的氏族...

scripts.text: What happened to them?
scripts.translation: 他们后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks at you with a melancholy face.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人用忧郁的神情看着你。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why are you interested in a clan that was abandoned by their lord and disappeared from history itself?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
为什么你要对一个被领主抛弃、甚至从历史中消失的氏族感兴趣呢？

scripts.text: I'm a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我是忍者。

scripts.text: I'm bored.
scripts.translation: 我有点无聊。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Was nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ninja! There was a time when the clan was called ninjas, too.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
忍者！曾经，这个氏族也被称为忍者。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You'll have to lend me your ear for I have so much to tell you about the clan story.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
请耐心听我说，关于这个氏族的故事，我有太多想告诉你的了。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The Old Man starts the story with a very soothing tone as if he is telling his grandchild a story.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人用非常柔和的语调开始讲述，就像在给孙辈讲故事一样。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
This goes way back to ancient times and nobody in Amatsu remembers about it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这要追溯到很久以前的古代，樱花城已经没有人记得这段历史了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The clan worked behind the scenes and basically lived their lives for their lord.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这个氏族在幕后运作，基本上是为了领主而活。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They were very loyal doing whatever deed their lord asked for.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他们非常忠诚，领主吩咐什么，他们就做什么。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ninja, the clan was known as the dark clan but that doesn't mean they wanted to be hidden in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
忍者，这个氏族被称为黑暗氏族，但这并不意味着他们想要隐藏在黑暗中。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They were loyal enough to be satisfied as the lord's servants but their loyalty became the problem.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他们足够忠诚，满足于做领主的仆人，但正是这种忠诚成了问题。

scripts.text: Problem?
scripts.translation: 问题？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
They are a secret organization that even the lord didn't know much about.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他们是一个秘密组织，连领主对他们知之甚少。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The few that knew about the clan's existence, tried to investigate them but nobody was able to reveal their true identity.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
少数知道这个氏族存在的人试图调查他们，但没有人能揭示他们的真实身份。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
That is why this clan has grown from loyal servants to a group feared for its secrets.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这就是为什么这个氏族从忠诚的仆人，变成了一个因秘密而令人恐惧的团体。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The lord shunned the clan and didn't call them for their service any more but they never betrayed him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
领主疏远了这个氏族，不再召唤他们服役，但他们从未背叛过他。

scripts.text: They were really loyal people.
scripts.translation: 他们真是忠诚的人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Yes, they were. Very loyal.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是的，他们很忠诚。非常忠诚。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6The old man looks even more forlorn.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6老人的神情显得更加落寞。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The clan has been living in hiding for so long since the old days. The current lord didn't even know of their existence.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
自远古以来，这个氏族一直生活在隐匿之中。现任领主甚至不知道他们的存在。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I'm Leader Gion, the last of the dark ninja clan.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我是首领 吉翁，黑暗忍者氏族最后的成员。

scripts.text: I think your time has ended.
scripts.translation: 我想你的时代已经结束了。

scripts.text: I need your teaching.
scripts.translation: 我想拜师学艺。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Are you an assassin to end this old man's life?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你是来取我这条老命的刺客吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So that is why you've shown interest in my clan. I won't give up easily.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
原来你对我这个氏族这么感兴趣。我不会轻易放弃的。

scripts.text:
Pow!!
^1A95E6You lose conscience with the great impact.^000000
scripts.translation:
砰！！
^1A95E6你被巨大的冲击力震得失去了意识。^000000

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Teaching...
Been a long time since I last heard that word.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
拜师...
好久没听到这个词了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I guess this little visit was not by coincidence but a start of a connection.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来这次偶遇并非巧合，而是某种缘分的开始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Sorry I am not a teacher. But!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
抱歉，我不是老师。但是！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I can help you on the path you've chosen, the ^33CC71{0}^000000 path.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我可以指引你走上你所选择的^33CC71{0}^000000之路。

scripts.text: ^1A95E6You hear Leader Gion's voice faintly as you slip away.^1A95E6
scripts.translation: ^1A95E6你在恍惚中听到首领 吉翁的声音渐渐远去。^1A95E6

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
If you are prepared to follow me, Leader Gion, on the {0} path, we will meet again.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你准备好跟随我，首领 吉翁，踏上{0}之路，我们还会再见的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I thought you were afraid of the ^33CC71path of the {0}^33CC71 and wouldn't come back.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我以为你害怕^33CC71{0}之路^33CC71，不会回来了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But from the look of your eyes, I guess I misjudged you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
但从你的眼神来看，看来是我看错你了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You will have to train your mind and body to walk steadily in the unknown world and never fall into temptation to stay on the path.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你必须磨练身心，才能在未知的世界中稳步前行，且不被诱惑而偏离正道。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Our ancestors had 4 tests to train our people.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我们的祖先有四项试炼来训练族人。

scripts.text: 4 tests?
scripts.translation: 四项试炼？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Yes, there are 4 tests.
My ancestors trained my people with 4 tests that involve ^087FF8knowledge^000000, ^087FF8survival^000000, ^087FF8weapons^000000, and ^087FF8battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
是的，共有四项试炼。
我的祖先通过涉及^087FF8知识^000000、^087FF8生存^000000、^087FF8武器^000000和^087FF8战斗^000000的四项试炼来训练族人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I know you are curious what these tests are. Let me explain one by one.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我知道你很好奇这些试炼是什么。让我逐一解释。

scripts.text: Test of Knowledge
scripts.translation: 知识试炼

scripts.text: Test of Survival
scripts.translation: 生存试炼

scripts.text: Test of Weaponry
scripts.translation: 武器试炼

scripts.text: Test of Battle
scripts.translation: 战斗试炼

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
We need to be knowledgeable in order to assist the lord. This test is for this purpose.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我们需要具备知识来辅佐领主。这项试炼正是为此而设。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You can pass the test if you successfully solve more than 9 out of 10 questions.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你能答对10道题中的9道以上，就能通过试炼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The test will be easy to pass if you've been steady in your studies. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你平时学习刻苦，这项试炼会很容易通过。那么，你还想了解哪项试炼？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Missions aren't always easy and safe. That is why survival instincts are vital to us.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
任务并不总是轻松且安全的。因此，生存本能对我们至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My ancestors call this test the dice test. It is a test to advance forward depending on the dice results.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的祖先称这项试炼为“骰子试炼”。它需要根据骰子的点数来决定前进的方向。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Think of it as the simple dice games people play.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你可以把它想象成人们常玩的简单骰子游戏。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But never let your guard down during the test because it isn't called the survival test for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
但在试炼中切勿掉以轻心，毕竟它被称为“生存试炼”绝非没有道理。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There will be blocks that help you while there are blocks that will interrupt you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
会有帮助你前进的方块，也会有阻碍你的方块。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
If you deal with various situations wisely, you will be able to pass the test. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你能明智地应对各种状况，就能通过试炼。那么，你还想了解哪项试炼？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My clan was famous for using unique weapons that we created.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的氏族以使用我们自制的独特武器而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You would be considered blessed if you created your own unique weapon.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你能打造出属于自己的独特武器，那将是一种荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Creating a weapon for yourself and refining it is the purpose of this test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
为自己打造武器并加以精炼，正是这项试炼的目的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope you will be blessed and find the best weapon for yourself. Now what other test are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
希望你能获得眷顾，找到最适合自己的武器。那么，你还想了解哪项试炼？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Missions are not always done alone. You will often work in teams of 2 or 3 for a common goal.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
任务并非总是独自完成的。为了共同的目标，你经常需要与2到3人组队行动。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The battle test is only for those that pass that knowledge, survival and weapon tests. So! It is the very last test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
战斗试炼仅面向通过了知识、生存和武器试炼的人。所以！这是最后一项试炼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Unlike the other three tests that are done alone, you will have to compete with others in this final test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
与其他三项独自进行的试炼不同，在这最后一项试炼中，你必须与他人竞争。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There is only one target!!
And only the first to get to the target passes the test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
只有一个目标！！
只有第一个到达目标的人才能通过试炼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You'll be lucky if you have no competitors during your test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
如果你在试炼中没有竞争对手，那真是走运了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
A challenge is better than explaining it a hundred times. It's the actual experience that makes you better.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
亲身体验比解释一百遍都更有意义。正是实际经历让你变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Seeing is believing, so go on and take the challenge.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
眼见为实，那就去接受挑战吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Let's start right away after you are done with preparations.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
等你准备就绪，我们就立刻开始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It's been a while.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
好久不见了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Since I felt happy like this. I feel young and energetic seeing young people like you challenge themselves with a new path.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
因为感到如此快乐，看着像你们这样的年轻人挑战自己、探索新道路，我觉得自己年轻又充满活力。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
We're done with explaining about the tests, now should I tell you my clan story?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
关于试炼的说明已经结束了，现在我要讲讲我氏族的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My clan started from two warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的氏族起源于两名战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Sun and the Moon.
The sunlight that lights up the world and the moonlight that lights up the night. Both were very similar but different warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
太阳与月亮。
照亮世界的阳光与照亮夜晚的月光。两者非常相似，却是不同的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There was a time there was an enmity between both warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
曾有一段时间，这两位战士之间产生了敌意。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But it didn't take long for them to become one as a clan.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
但没过多久，他们就合二为一，成为了一个氏族。

scripts.text: How did it go afterwards?
scripts.translation: 后来怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Ha ha ha. It is never fun to listen to the whole story all at once, no? Come back after passing a test and I'll continue my story.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
哈哈哈哈哈。一口气听完整个故事并不有趣，对吧？通过试炼后再回来，我会继续讲我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Which test will you select as your first test?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你选择哪项试炼作为你的第一项试炼？

scripts.text: Test of Knowledge
scripts.translation: 知识试炼

scripts.text: Test of Survival
scripts.translation: 生存试炼

scripts.text: Test of Weaponry
scripts.translation: 武器试炼

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了知识试炼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Survival.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了生存试炼。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the Test of Weaponry.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了武器试炼。

scripts.text: [Leader Gion]
scripts.translation: [首领 吉翁]

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My friend doesn't approve of others that easily but I guess he liked you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的朋友不轻易认可他人，但我想他喜欢你。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you went through hell with this test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来你在这项试炼中经历了一番地狱般的考验。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I wonder if Joe is satisfied with your performance.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
不知道乔对你的表现是否满意。

scripts.text: Please continue with the clan story.
scripts.translation: 请继续讲述氏族的故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you are pretty eager to hear more. Where did I leave off... Ah! I remember.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来你很急切地想听后续。我讲到哪儿了...啊！我想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Both warriors weren't close at first, because personality and everything else was completely opposite of each other.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
起初这两位战士并不亲近，因为他们的性格和各方面都截然相反。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The first place they met was the battlefield. And you know how enemies greet each other on a battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
他们第一次相遇是在战场上。你知道敌人在战场上是如何互相问候的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
They ended up injuring each other badly.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
结果他们互相受了重伤。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But what can you do? War is a war.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
但又能怎么办呢？战争就是战争。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The friend you've laughed with yesterday is a foe that you have to fight with in a war today.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
昨天还能一起谈笑的朋友，今天可能就是战争中必须对抗的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So nobody can get along with anyone during a war.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
所以在战争中，没有人能与他人和睦相处。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'll continue the story after you pass another test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
等你通过另一项试炼后，我再继续讲故事。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Which test will you choose for the second test?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
第二项试炼，你想选择哪一项？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Survival^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了^339CCC知识与生存试炼^000000！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Knowledge and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了^339CCC知识与武器试炼^000000！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've passed the ^339CCCTests of Survival and Weaponry^000000!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你通过了^339CCC生存与武器试炼^000000！

scripts.text: [Leader Gion]
scripts.translation: [首领 吉翁]

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You are already done with two tests. Hope you've learned a lot from them.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你已经完成了两项试炼。希望你在其中有所收获。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Shall we continue with the story?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我们要继续讲故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I think I left off when the two warriors met at the battlefield as enemies.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我想我上次讲到两位战士作为敌人在战场上相遇的时候。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The long war ended eventually but the wounds and pain of those that survived had just started.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
漫长的战争终于结束了，但幸存者的伤痛和痛苦才刚刚开始。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
So these two warriors started to embrace and heal the war wounds together and became one.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
于是这两位战士开始相互扶持，共同治愈战争的创伤，并合二为一。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There is a backstory of a man appearing in front of them and winning the loyalty from both warriors.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
还有一个背景故事，关于一名男子出现在他们面前，并赢得了两位战士的忠诚。

scripts.text: Who is this man?
scripts.translation: 这个人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
There isn't much known about this man. Only a short mentioning of the two warriors pledging their allegiance.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
关于这个人，已知的信息不多。只有关于两位战士宣誓效忠的简短记载。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Maybe current generations like me are the ancestors of the current Amatsu lord? But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
也许像我这样的当代人，是现任樱花城领主的祖先？但这只是推测。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm almost at the end of my clan story. Come back after you've passed the third test and I will tell you the rest.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的氏族故事快讲完了。等你通过第三项考验后再来，我会告诉你剩下的部分。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've gone through three tests leaving only one to pass.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你已经通过了三项考验，只剩最后一项了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
As I've told you before, the last test is different because you have to compete against others.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
正如我之前所说，最后一项考验不同，因为你需要与其他人竞争。

scripts.text: Will you continue the story?
scripts.translation: 要继续故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Ha ha ha. I will finish the story.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
哈哈。我会讲完故事的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Kagerou, a warrior like the dancing flames of the sun.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
影狼，如太阳的舞焰般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Oboro, a warrior like the misty moonlight.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
胧，如朦胧月光般的战士。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It is told that the man that earned the loyalty of the two warriors was a humorous person.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
据说赢得两位战士忠诚的那个人，是个幽默的人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
He like the jokes and conversations better than quarrels and he liked women over men.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
比起争吵，他更喜欢玩笑和交谈；比起男人，他更喜欢女人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Hmm... I don't know why this part of the story was kept alive all these years but this man wanted to bring these two warriors together.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
嗯...我不知道为什么这部分故事流传了这么多年，但这个人想把这两位战士撮合在一起。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Both warriors did travel together after the war but kept an awkward distance from each other.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
战后，两位战士确实一起旅行，但彼此保持着尴尬的距离。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
They must have had their reasons but their lord would send them out to a difficult mission together, put them in a secret room together and all sorts of situations together.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
他们肯定有自己的理由，但他们的领主会派他们一起执行艰难的任务，把他们关在密室里，或者安排各种让他们在一起的情况。

scripts.text: Sounds like an odd person.
scripts.translation: 听起来像个怪人。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Yes, he was. And his efforts didn't go in vain since the two warriors eventually got acquainted and married.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
是的，他就是那样。他的努力没有白费，两位战士最终相识并结为夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
This is how the clan started.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
氏族就是这样开始的。

scripts.text: What happened after?
scripts.translation: 后来发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Sadly, the next part of story was purposely discontinued.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
遗憾的是，故事的下一部分被故意中断了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I think it's because someone wanted us to let go of the past and move forward.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我想这是因为有人希望我们放下过去，向前看。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
That's that. Now shouldn't you be preparing for the last test?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
就是这样。现在你不该去准备最后一项考验吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But you must be tired from all the tests so far. Take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
不过，经历了这么多考验，你一定累坏了吧。好好休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Weren't you taking the Test of {0} just now?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你刚才不是正在参加{0}的考验吗？

scripts.text: I want to go back to test site.
scripts.translation: 我想回到考验地点。

scripts.text: Ah... no.
scripts.translation: 啊...不了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Test of {0} site is over here.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
{0}的考验地点在这边。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The village is over here.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
村庄在那边。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You've come back already? You could have rested more. Is there a reason to hurry?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
这么快就回来了？你本可以多休息一会儿的。有什么急事吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Because of ^B24E59{0}^000000?

[Leader Gion]
I have to admit, I don't understand you now.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我得承认，我现在有点看不懂你了。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But since you've gone through much, I'm sure you will do good with the final test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
不过既然你已经经历了这么多，我相信你一定能顺利通过最后的考验。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Now! No more small talk. I'll let you know what the target is for the Test of Battle.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
好了！不再闲聊了。我来告诉你战斗考验的目标是什么。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The target is a monster called the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
目标是名为^FF0000氏族秘密^000000的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You will have to be careful because there are many similiar shaped and named monsters in test site.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你要小心，因为考验地点有很多外形和名字都很相似的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
And if you are lucky, there will be others targeting the monster.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
而且如果你运气好，还会有其他人也在攻击这只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
May the blessings of '{0}' be with you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
愿'{0}'的赐福与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Then let's go to the battle test field.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
那么，让我们去战斗考验场吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I see you are in the middle of the ^339CCCTest of Battle^000000. Will you go back to the test site?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来你正在参加^339CCC战斗考验^000000。要回到考验地点吗？

scripts.text: Go back to the test site.
scripts.translation: 回到考验地点

scripts.text: Visit the village.
scripts.translation: 去村庄

The test site is over here.

考验地点在这边。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The village is over here.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
村庄在那边。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You should not be here. Leave!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你不该出现在这里。离开！

scripts.text: Install a trap.
scripts.translation: 安装陷阱

scripts.text: Do not install.
scripts.translation: 不安装

scripts.text: < Used {0} LP >
scripts.translation: < 消耗了 {0} LP >

scripts.text: The trap is installed. Please roll the dice.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已安装。请掷骰子。

scripts.text: Did not set a trap. Please roll the dice.
scripts.translation: 未设置陷阱。请掷骰子。

scripts.text: You are caught in the trap installed. Press Close to go back to block 0.
scripts.translation: 你触发了已安装的陷阱。点击关闭以回到0号格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move forward {0} blocks.
scripts.translation: 点击关闭以向前移动{0}格。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 标示上有细小的文字。

scripts.text: Now there is only 1 block left till the end. Congratulations on all you've been through to get here.
scripts.translation: 现在距离终点只剩1格了。恭喜你能走到这里。

scripts.text: But you cannot go so easily. If you get a 3, you will go back to block 3.
scripts.translation: 但你不能这么轻易地过去。如果掷出3，你将回到3号格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the 3rd block.
scripts.translation: 点击关闭以移动到3号格子。

scripts.text: Press Close to move to the arrival point.
scripts.translation: 点击关闭以移动到终点。

scripts.text: You should not be here.
scripts.translation: 你不应该在这里。

scripts.text: You must be here by mistake.
scripts.translation: 你一定是走错地方了。

scripts.text: There are tiny letters on the sign.
scripts.translation: 标示上有细小的文字。

scripts.text:
To those you are preparing for a new turn...
Well begun is half done. However always remember it is not the end.
scripts.translation:
给那些正准备开始新一轮的人...
好的开始是成功的一半。但请记住，这还不是结束。

scripts.text:
Let's read all the writing on the sign.
You feel like you are moved to another place.
scripts.translation:
让我们读一读标示上的所有文字。
你感觉自己仿佛被传送到了另一个地方。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Go reduce your weight! This test will be too difficult otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
去减减肥！不然这测试会很难通过...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Sorry, your clan is not the same as ours, is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
抱歉，你的氏族不是我们的，是不是有什么误会？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You are not supposed to be here...
It's my duty to get rid of you,
so I'll send you back now!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你不应该出现在这里...
清除你是我的职责，
所以我现在就把你送回去！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
It's been a while!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好久不见！

scripts.text: Long time indeed, Joe.
scripts.translation: 确实很久了，乔。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You aren't surprised I'm here. Did you meet ^0237FDKuuga Gai^000000 before coming here?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你对我出现在这里并不感到惊讶。来之前你见过^0237FD空牙·盖^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Don't like it that I'm not the first one you visited but that is not important.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我不喜欢你没先拜访我，但这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright, {0}!
Welcome to the workshop where weapons are created for the clan.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好了，{0}！
欢迎来到为氏族打造武器的工坊。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Our clan has been creating and using unique weapons to serve our secret missions since ancient times.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
自古以来，我们的氏族就一直在制造和使用独特的武器，以执行秘密任务。

scripts.text: Really? At Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 真的吗？在艾音布罗克？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm? You are not as slow as I thought you were!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
嗯？你并不像我想象中那么迟钝！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Yes. Einbroch is known as an industrial city, the city of great blacksmiths create new technology.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
是的。艾音布罗克以工业城市闻名，伟大的铁匠们在这里创造新技术。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
My mission is to analyze their technology and report back to the clan.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我的任务是解析他们的技术，并向氏族汇报。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I spoke more than I intended to.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我说的比预想的多了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Did you bring enough ^6848B7Iron Ore, Iron, Steel, Phracon, Emveretaron, Rough Oridecon, and Rough Elunium^000000?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你带了足够的^6848B7铁矿石、铁、钢、强化武器金属-级数一、Emveretaron、神之金属原石和铝原石^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Let's now create a new prototype weapon.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
现在让我们制造一把新的原型武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
请随意使用这里的工具，还有...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
...there...

[Red Leopard Joe]
...and everywhere else. Now let's begin!!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
...以及其他地方。现在让我们开始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Interesting... Is it a dagger in a shape of a Kunai?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
嗯...有意思...这是一把呈苦无形状的短剑吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Very creative. I do see room for improvement but the weapon itself may come out useful after smoothing it out a bit.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
非常有创意。虽然还有改进的空间，但稍微打磨一下后，这把武器可能会很有用。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Is this an Ordinary Huuma?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
嗯...这是一把普通的武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh, Its not an Ordinary Huuma.
Very creative. I do see room for improvement but the weapon itself may come out useful after smoothing it out a bit.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
啊，这不是普通的武器。
非常有创意。虽然还有改进的空间，但稍微打磨一下后，这把武器可能会很有用。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh, how is it possible? You don't have weapons? Maybe you equipped it?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
啊，这怎么可能？你没有武器吗？也许你把它装备上了？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Good. I think you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
很好。我觉得你准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Now it's time to upgrade?
There are refinement tools on both sides of me. Use those to refine a weapon and come back.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
现在是时候进行强化了。
我两边都有强化工具。用它们强化武器，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I created the refinement tools myself with great effort so you won't have any trouble using them.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
这些强化工具是我费尽心思制作的，所以你使用时不会有任何困难。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ah... But just in case,
^FF0000be careful not to cause trouble by showing these to blacksmiths outside of here.^000000
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
啊...不过以防万一，
^FF0000小心不要把这些东西拿给这里的铁匠看，以免惹上麻烦。^000000

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Did you get a successful result?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你得到满意的结果了吗？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好。

scripts.text: Here it is.
scripts.translation: 在这里。

scripts.text: Actually...
scripts.translation: 实际上...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
It isn't easy to get a satisfactory result at first.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
一开始很难得到满意的结果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You've lost the weapon even with my warning.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
即使我警告过你，你还是失去了武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Nothing else we can do. Wait!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我们别无他法。等等！

scripts.text: Red Leopard Joe mumbles something and suddenly all weapons are unequipped.
scripts.translation: 红豹 乔嘟囔了几句，突然所有武器都被卸下了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
What is this? You still have the prototype. Stop playing around.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
这是什么？你还有原型。别胡闹了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh! You really lost it.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
哦！你真的弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Well! Lets try to make it again!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
好吧！让我们再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Looks like you've got some results.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
看起来你得到了一些结果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ahh! You have not equipped any weapons!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
啊！你没有装备任何武器！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Is that weapon yours? Let me have a look.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
那把武器是你的吗？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you certain it's that weapon?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你确定是那把武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You plan to trick me with that? Again!!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你打算用这种把戏骗我？又是这样！！

scripts.text: Joe took a thorough look at the seal.
scripts.translation: 乔仔细检查了海豹宝宝。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you that low?
I must have misjudged you. You might have been satisfied yourself but I'm not. Do it again!!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你的水平就这么低吗？
看来是我看错你了。你自己可能觉得满意了，但我并不满意。再做一次！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Is this your limit?
You've just made it that close to passing. I will ask one more time, are you satisfied?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
嗯...这就是你的极限了吗？
你离通过只差一步之遥。我再问一次，你满意吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You're still here. Why?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你还在这里。为什么？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你的能力足够了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Ah, as I expected.
I still believe that you will not stop here.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
啊，果然如此。
我依然相信你不会止步于此。

scripts.text: I want to stop.
scripts.translation: 我想停止。

scripts.text: I want to continue.
scripts.translation: 我想继续。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I will look forward for your result.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我会期待你的成果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你的能力足够了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Better than expected.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
比预期的要好。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For beginners, quite good. This test may not be significant to you, but your competence is enough.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
对于初学者来说，相当不错。这次测试对你来说可能不算什么，但你的能力足够了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I can feel it.
I will take this weapon to give it some finishing touches.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我能感觉到。
我会把这件武器拿去进行最后的修饰。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
'{0}'
Passed the weapon test!!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
'{0}'
通过了武器测试！！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, I almost forgot.
Go report the test results to Gion!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
哦，我差点忘了。
去把测试结果汇报给吉恩！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You should not have come here...
It's my duty to get rid of you.
This will push you back!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你不该来这里...
除掉你是我的职责。
这一击会把你打回去！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Are you done making the prototype of the new weapons?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
新武器的原型制作好了吗？

scripts.text: Crafting tools?
scripts.translation: 制作工具？

scripts.text: I don't have enough materials.
scripts.translation: 材料不足。

scripts.text: How do you expect me to make a weapon?{0}
scripts.translation: 你指望我怎么制作武器？{0}

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Feel free to use tools from here, and...
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
请随意使用这里的工具，还有...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
...there...

[Red Leopard Joe]
...and everywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
...以及其它地方。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You haven't brought enough materials?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
你带的材料不够吗？

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Then we'll have to pay a visit to the village. Try the ^FF0000drawer^000000 over there. It'll take you to the village.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
那我们得去一趟村庄。试试那边的^FF0000抽屉^000000，它会带你去村庄。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Hmm... Guess I expected too much? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
嗯...看来是我期望太高了？让我解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You first have to melt the ore to use for the weapon. And the best way to get high purity metal is to melt materials that are of the same kind.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
首先，你必须熔炼矿石才能用于制作武器。而获得高纯度金属的最佳方法，是熔炼同种类的材质。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For example, Iron Ore, Iron, and Steel are of similar property so you can get a high purity metal out of them.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
例如，铁矿石、铁和钢的性质相似，因此可以从中获得高纯度金属。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Once you've melted a high purity metal, pour it in a mold to get the shape of the weapon and then make it firm through grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
一旦熔炼出高纯度金属，将其倒入模具中形成武器的形状，然后通过研磨和淬火使其定型。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
By the way, you will get the best results by thoroughly rotating, grinding and tempering.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
顺便说一句，充分进行旋转、研磨和淬火，你会得到最好的效果。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I think this is enough to get you started, don't you think? Now go and work on that prototype!!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我觉得这些足以让你入门了，你觉得呢？现在去制作那个原型吧！！

scripts.text: There is some kind of device on the drawer.
scripts.translation: 抽屉上有一种装置。

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Try to operate it.
scripts.translation: 尝试操作它。

scripts.text: Clank clunk clink
scripts.translation: 咔哒 咔哒 叮当

scripts.text: Too heavy! Please reduce your weight.
scripts.translation: 太重了！请减轻你的重量。

scripts.text:
A crafting tool.
Don't really need it now.
scripts.translation:
制作工具。
现在似乎用不上。

scripts.text: Tool to create weapons.
scripts.translation: 用于制作武器的工具。

scripts.text: First need to melt metals like iron and iron ore to use to create a weapon.
scripts.translation: 首先需要熔炼铁、铁矿石等金属，用于制作武器。

scripts.text: Melt Iron Ore.
scripts.translation: 熔炼铁矿石。

scripts.text: Melt Iron.
scripts.translation: 熔炼铁。

scripts.text: Melt Steel.
scripts.translation: 熔炼钢。

scripts.text: Melt Phracon.
scripts.translation: 熔炼强化武器金属-级数一。

scripts.text: Melt Emveretarcon.
scripts.translation: 熔炼强化武器金属-级数二

scripts.text: Melt Rough Oridecon.
scripts.translation: 熔炼神之金属原石

scripts.text: Melt Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation: 熔炼铝原石

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Melted {0} in high temperature.
scripts.translation: 在高温下熔炼了{0}。

scripts.text: Don't have {0}.
Which metal will be melted next?
scripts.translation: 接下来要熔炼哪种金属？

scripts.text: Now the metal is melted to use for creating weapons.
scripts.translation: 现在金属已经熔化，可以用来制作武器了。

scripts.text: Next is to make the melted metal firm by pouring it into a mold. Which mold shape will you use?
scripts.translation: 接下来是将熔化的金属倒入模具中使其定型。您打算使用哪种形状的模具？

scripts.text: Dagger Mold
scripts.translation: 短剑模具

scripts.text: Shuriken Mold
scripts.translation: 飞镖模具

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the dagger mold.
scripts.translation: 将熔化的金属倒入了短剑模具中。

scripts.text: Poured the melted metal into the shuriken mold.
scripts.translation: 将熔化的金属倒入了飞镖模具中。

scripts.text: Looks like the metal is taking shape. Now what next?
scripts.translation: 看起来金属正在成型。接下来该做什么？

scripts.text: Now what next?
scripts.translation: 接下来该做什么？

scripts.text: Start to sharpen the tool using a whetstone for finishing touches.
scripts.translation: 开始使用磨刀石进行最后的打磨。

scripts.text: The weapon was created successfully.
scripts.translation: 武器制作成功。

scripts.text: Let's take it to Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation: 让我们把它带给红豹 乔。

scripts.text: The weapon was destroyed while doing the finishing touches to it.
scripts.translation: 在进行最后的打磨时，武器被损坏了。

scripts.text: There must have been something missed while creating the weapon. Very sad this happened but you'll have to start all over again.
scripts.translation: 制作武器时一定有什么地方疏忽了。虽然很遗憾，但您不得不重新开始。

scripts.text: But you do not have any more metal to melt. Let's try again after getting more metal.
scripts.translation: 但是您没有更多可以熔炼的金属了。等获取更多金属后再试试吧。

scripts.text: Grind the weapon
scripts.translation: 打磨武器

scripts.text: Temper the weapon{0}
scripts.translation: 淬火武器{0}

scripts.text: Ground the weapon.
scripts.translation: 已打磨武器。

scripts.text: Tempered the weapon.
scripts.translation: 已淬火武器。

scripts.text: This tool helps you refine your weapons automatically. However, you won't need this just now.
scripts.translation: 这个工具可以自动帮您精炼武器。不过，您现在还用不上它。

scripts.text:
You turn on the refinement tool.
The equipment starts up with a pleasant vibration.
scripts.translation:
您启动了精炼工具。
设备伴随着令人愉悦的震动开始运转。

scripts.text: Looks like you can use the tool right away for refinement because it holds a good deal of Elunium and Oridecon within it.
scripts.translation: 看起来您可以立即使用这个工具进行精炼，因为它内部含有大量的铝和神之金属。

scripts.text: Start refining.
scripts.translation: 开始精炼

scripts.text: Do not start refining.
scripts.translation: 不开始精炼

scripts.text: You turned off the tool.
scripts.translation: 您关闭了工具。

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
哔——
工具发出了警告声。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
This equipment does not work without an equipped item to refine.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
如果没有装备待精炼的物品，这台设备无法工作。

scripts.text: Analyzing the weapon.
scripts.translation: 正在分析武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Wait... this weapon is not a customized one.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
等等...这把武器不是定制武器。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Why don't you refine this with those hot-headed blacksmiths out there?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
您为什么不去找外面那些脾气火爆的铁匠精炼呢？

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
哔——
工具发出了警告声。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
That weapon cannot be refined. Where did you get it?
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
这把武器无法精炼。您是从哪里弄来的？

scripts.text:
Bzzzt
A warning beep comes from the tool.
scripts.translation:
哔——
工具发出了警告声。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
This equipment is perfectly refined. Keep it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
这件装备已经完美精炼了。请留作自用吧！

scripts.text: This is very well refined equipment. Do you want to continue? Refine skill decreases by 1 if refinement fails.
scripts.translation: 这是一件精炼度很高的装备。您确定要继续吗？如果精炼失败，精炼技能将降低1点。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: You turned off the tool.
scripts.translation: 您关闭了工具。

scripts.text: Starting to refine.
scripts.translation: 开始精炼。

scripts.text:
Succeeded in refining.
Turned off the refining tool.
scripts.translation:
精炼成功。
已关闭精炼工具。

scripts.text:
Failed in refining.
Your weapon refinement skill dropped by 1.
Turned off the refining tool.
scripts.translation:
精炼失败。
您的武器精炼技能下降了1点。
已关闭精炼工具。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You don't need so many things now!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你现在不需要这么多东西了！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you haven't taken care of the target yet.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来你还没有处理掉目标。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'll tell you once more. The target is the ^FF0000Clan Secret^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我再告诉你一次。目标是^FF0000氏族秘宝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Of course the path will be difficult, so continue searching!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
当然，路途会很艰难，所以请继续寻找！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Looks like you've taken care of the target. Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
看来你已经处理掉目标了。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
But please get down from your frog. Otherwise I can't continue!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
请从青蛙上下来。否则我无法继续！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
How did you get weaker? Come back once you've regained your previous levels.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你怎么变弱了？等你恢复到之前的等级后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
Please come back after using all your Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
请在使用完所有技能点后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
The Test of Battle will be put off for a while. Don't worry because this does not have affect to other tests.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
战斗测试将暂时推迟。不用担心，这不会影响其他测试。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
My friend {0} made it to {1} Path. Congratulations!!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我的朋友{0}通过了{1}之路。恭喜！！

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
It is pleasant to meet a youth that is walking through a new path.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
很高兴见到一位正在探索新道路的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Someone's Voice]
Wait for a while, Gion.
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
吉翁，等一下。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm sorry I almost forgot about you two. Do you have anything to share with {0}?
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
抱歉，我差点忘了你们两个。你们有什么想对{0}说的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hmm... Embarrassing... to speak so suddenly...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
嗯...突然说这些...有点尴尬...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
{0}, you are now a proud member of our clan. Always hold your head high and...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
{0}，你现在是我们氏族引以为傲的成员。请永远昂首挺胸，并且...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
^777777(Gai's voice fades out.)^000000.
I'm sorry I strangled you when we first met.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
^777777（盖的声音渐渐消失。）^000000
抱歉，我们第一次见面时我掐住了你的脖子。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Puhahaha! Gai is all talk. I know I was know valuable to you than that Gai.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
噗哈哈！盖只会说大话。我知道我比那个盖对你更有价值。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I did some work on the prototype {0} you made.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我对你制作的{0}原型做了一些加工。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
{0} now shines beautifully with a scarlet glow after I did the finishing touches.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
经过我的最后修饰，{0}现在闪耀着美丽的猩红光芒。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
I named your weapons on my own but I know you'll like the name.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
我擅自给你的武器起了名字，但我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Leader Gion, please continue.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
首领 吉翁，请继续。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I don't have much to add because Gai and Joe said it all.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
盖和乔已经把话说完了，我没什么要补充的。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I'm just sorry that the environment of all these tests could have been better for our later generation.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
我只是很遗憾，这些测试的环境本可以更好，以便造福我们的后代。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You only need to look forward and never turn back.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你只需要向前看，不要回头。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
愿影狼的祝福、舞动的太阳以及胧的朦胧月光，伴随你前行的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
I hope the blessings of Kagerou, dancing sun and Oboro, misty moonlight will be with you on your journey ahead.
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
愿影狼的祝福、舞动的太阳以及胧的朦胧月光，伴随你前行的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Leader Gion]
You should not be here. Please leave!
scripts.translation:
[首领 吉翁]
你不该在这里。请离开！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Congratulation for choosing the road of development!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·盖]
祝贺你选择了这条成长之路！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
You have not found the target? Continue searching it.
scripts.translation:
[红豹 乔]
还没找到目标吗？继续寻找。
